name: files
description: Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, organize, and serve an evidence vault. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (files-serve) + generated SDK. The client uses the hosted HTTP API when HASNA_FILES_API_URL + HASNA_FILES_API_KEY are set, else local SQLite; files-serve uses PostgreSQL when HASNA_FILES_DATABASE_URL is set, with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts; file bytes stay in S3.

Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, organize, and serve an evidence vault. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (files-serve) + SDK. SQLite at ~/.hasna/files/files.db is authoritative when no DATABASE_URL is configured; with one, the serve process reads/writes operator-owned PostgreSQL directly. File bytes stay in S3.

serviceSurfaces.name: files-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The typed SDK ships and is generated from src/server/openapi.ts, but the service contract requires a supported service SDK to be generated from the API's served OpenAPI document, and files-serve publishes no /openapi.json route.
